fields.label: Key
fields.description: A short name in lower case, for example balaji.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: What the person sees, for example Tirupati Balaji.

fields.label: Deity
fields.description: The deity, to group the gallery, for example Hanuman.

fields.label: Mandir or place
fields.description: Where the picture was taken or the mandir it stands for.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: The lowest number comes first in the gallery.

fields.label: YouTube channel id
fields.description: Makes this a live darshan: the temple screen plays whatever this channel is streaming now, through YouTube's own player. The id starts with UC and is 24 characters.

fields.label: YouTube video id
fields.description: Optional, 11 characters. A particular live video to play instead of whatever the channel streams now, for a stream that runs all day. Blank: the channel's current stream.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: Shown under the stream as its source.

fields.label: The temple's own channel
fields.description: Tick only for the temple's or the trust's own channel. Others are shown as relayed by the channel.

fields.label: Aarti and darshan times
fields.description: Shown with the stream, for example Morning aarti 4:00, evening aarti 7:00.

fields.label: Picture
fields.description: A tall picture of the deity, ideally 900 pixels wide or more. Only a picture you have the right to use. Leave blank for a live darshan.

fields.label: Credit
fields.description: Who made the picture; shown under it when one is needed.

fields.label: Licence
fields.description: For example CC0, CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, Owned, Licensed.

fields.label: Where it came from
fields.description: The page the picture was taken from, or a note of who gave permission.

fields.label: The mandir's own donation page
fields.description: Only the mandir's official page. A Donate button opens it in a new tab; no money passes through us.
